milestones.name: Deno Migration
milestones.goal: Convert the SvelteKit site from Node/adapter-static to SvelteKit + Deno Deploy. Site live at a real domain.

tasks.description: Swap `@sveltejs/adapter-static` for the Deno adapter
tasks.notes: `@sveltejs/adapter-deno` does not exist; used the community-standard `svelte-adapter-deno@0.9.1`, which required upgrading SvelteKit 1 → 2 (plus Vite 4 → 5, Svelte 4.0 → 4.2). `svelte-check` passes clean.

tasks.description: Update `svelte.config.js` to Deno adapter config (`out: 'build'`, `precompress: true`)
Verify all dependencies are compatible with Deno runtime
tasks.notes: Only runtime dep is `@fontsource/inter` (bundled CSS at build); no Node-only builtins in app code; server boots and serves under Deno 2.6

tasks.description: Add `deno.json` config at project root (`deno task start` runs the built server)
Update build script and CI
tasks.notes: `npm run build` produces the Deno server; `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` deploys via `deployctl` on push to main (project name placeholder until 1DE.6)

tasks.description: Set up Deno Deploy project and link to repository
tasks.notes: Manual: requires dash.deno.com account access; see DEPLOY.md

tasks.description: Configure custom domain on Deno Deploy
tasks.notes: Manual: requires DNS access; see DEPLOY.md

tasks.description: Smoke test all routes locally under Deno (homepage, catalog, draw, about, card pages incl. majors, 404 case)
Re-run smoke test checklist against the live deployment

milestones.name: Visual Identity
milestones.goal: Replace placeholder component symbols with Joy Division Unknown Pleasures-esque SVG line art — one unique illustration per card.

tasks.description: SVG illustration system defined — 200×300 viewBox (2:3), white 1.2px ridge lines on black (Unknown Pleasures idiom), occluding silhouette fills, card label (Roman numerals for majors) and name as SVG text
Generation approach — parameterised generator in `src/lib/illustration.ts`: deterministic seed from card id (xmur3 + mulberry32), suit-specific line character, rank-scaled intensity; no image assets
Wands illustrations — energetic, tall peaks (generated, 14 cards)
Cups illustrations — smooth rolling waves (generated, 14 cards)
Swords illustrations — sharp, jagged, high-frequency (generated, 14 cards)
Pentacles illustrations — steady, dense, modest (generated, 14 cards)
Major Arcana illustrations — denser, taller, more dramatic (generated, 22 cards)
`CardPlaceholder.svelte` rewritten to render the per-card SVG
Render check — single scalable SVG per card; verified rasterised output across suits; catalog page weighs 1.45MB raw / ~175KB gzipped (precompressed brotli emitted at build)
